notes:
Lead origin: inbound from sales enablement app integration (customer discovered Redwood via partner integration post).

Quick summary / context:
- Small startup building a call-summary + coaching layer for SMB sales teams. Heavy on real-time summaries, short-term storage for coaching loops, and search across 6 months of aggregated metrics.
- Primary interest: hosted_api (self-serve) to speed time-to-market; likely upgrade path to Dedicated if usage grows.
- Common ask: how we handle PII inside transcripts, retention windows, redact options, and ability to purge on-demand.

Technical / business requirements (customer-said):
- Workload: streaming call summarization + batched post-call topic extraction.
- Latency target: end-to-end summary <= 500ms for live streaming use, acceptable in many flows up to 1s.
- Throughput: tiny to start (hundreds of requests/day) but spikes with campaigns. Cost-sensitive.
- Model preferences: small/medium open models OK if latency/cost confirm; willing to use redwood-verified model profiles.
- Routing/fallback: want predictable fallback to cheaper model if primary congested; no region constraints initially (US only).

Security / compliance notes:
- Inbound concern: PII (customer names, payment info sometimes read out). They want default retention 30 days, with option to purge per-tenant.
- Requirements: SSO/SAML for admin UI, audit logging for transcript access, and proof of deletion for legal requests.
- Customer asked about encryption (KMS) and whether transcripts are stored encrypted at rest in hosted offering (we confirmed yes).

POC plan discussed:
- 1-week POC using hosted_api with sample transcripts (anonymized then a second pass with PII).
- Deliverables: sample retention config, redaction demo (redact-on-write vs redact-on-read), short runbook for deletion request flow.
- Success metric: ability to demonstrate automated purge and redact tooling + acceptable latency and cost estimate.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We can't keep raw transcripts longer than 30 days — our legal team will push back otherwise." — VP Sales Marcus Lee
- "If Redwood can show us a simple retention config and audit trail, we'll feel comfortable starting a paid POC." — CEO Anika Rao

Open items / actionables:
- SE to produce a trimmed security FAQ and a sample retention JSON for hosted_api (Daniel).
- Send link to redact sample code + short demo video.
- Legal wants deletion SLA language inserted into SOW if we move to procurement.

Notes on commercial sensitivity / objections:
- Price sensitivity: they want per-call metering to remain low; will compare to Otter/Fireflies.
- Likely buyer: VP Sales (economic), CEO signs off, legal approves retention/SLA.

Suggested messaging for next outreach:
- Emphasize hosted_api self-serve credit tier + easy retention toggles, show a one-click purge flow in Console, include short audit-log screenshot.
